sloka: द्रुमकुल्य इति ख्यातो लोके ख्यातो यथा भवान् ।उग्रदर्शनकर्माणो बहवस्तत्र दस्यवः ॥६-२२-३२॥।।
transliteration: drumakulya iti khyāto loke khyāto yathā bhavān ।ugradarśanakarmāṇo bahavastatra dasyavaḥ ॥6-22-32॥।।

translations.english: "Marauders of terrific action, who are enemies of gods whose chief is Abhiras, live there drinking my (ocean) water performing sinful acts."
